the study of the four-nucleon scattering states in the framework of the Faddeev equations in the hyperspherical harmonics basis.
the structure of the four nucleon scattering wave functions and their application to the calculation of cross section and other observables.
the study of the 4N system in the framework of the three-nucleon force.
